topic: StemDeck, a free, open-source and local AI stem separator
headline: StemDeck Revolutionizes AI Stem Separation
caption:
Excited to see open-source projects like StemDeck making waves in AI tool development. Its local execution means no data leaks and full control - perfect for sensitive STEM work. As a full stack engineer, I appreciate how approachable and customizable it is. It's inspiring to see our community focus on open privacy-first AI solutions. Dive into its code and see how you can adapt it for your projects. Let’s keep pushing for ethical and transparent AI tools! 🚀 

#OpenSource #AI #StemTech
